headline: Midland County Home Backup Report
summary: Homes in Midland County face a long outage about once every 13 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 28% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth went without power for about 65 hours. In May 2024, 7% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth went without power for about 23 hours. One Core lasts about 18 hours in January. One Core lasts about 37 hours in April. Two Cores last about 34 hours in January. Two Cores cover 88% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
